name: api_countOfEventSubscriptions
description: Returns the count of event subscriptions that have been configured or created. Use this tool when the user asks about the number of active event subscriptions. It can answer questions like How many event subscriptions are configured? or Give me the count of all event subscriptions.

name: api_countOfEvents
description: Get the count of registered events with provided eventIds or tags as mandatory

name: api_countOfNotifications
description: Get the Count of Published Notifications based on the various inputs from the user. It can answer questions like How many notifications are there for event X? or Give me the count of all notifications and many more combinations

name: api_downloadReportContent
description: Returns report content. Save the response to a file by converting the response data as a blob and setting the file format available from content-disposition response header.

name: api_eventArtifactCount
description: Get the total count of registered event artifacts. Event artifacts are event definitions or templates available in the system. It can answer questions like How many event artifacts are there? or Give me the count of all event artifacts.

name: api_getAllExecutionDetailsForAGivenReport
description: Get details of all executions for a given report

name: api_getEventArtifacts

name: api_getEventSubscriptions
description: Gets the list of all event subscriptions regardless of connector type (REST/Webhook, Email, Syslog, etc.). Use this tool when the user asks for all subscriptions, subscription details, or wants to see configured event subscriptions without specifying a particular connector type. It can answer questions like 'Show me all event subscriptions', 'List my subscriptions', 'What subscriptions are configured?', or 'Get subscription details'.

name: api_getEvents
description: Gets the list of registered Events with provided eventIds or tags as mandatory

name: api_getExecutionIdByReportId
description: Get Execution Id by Report Id

name: api_getFailedITSMEvents
description: Used to retrieve the list of integration events that failed to create tickets in ITSM

name: api_getNotifications
description: Gets the Published Notifications based on the various inputs from the user. It can answer questions like have there been any notifications for event X? or Give me a list of all notifications and many more combinations. Always use this API with a limit and if the user does not give it, only fetch 5 records and do not allow more than 10 records to be fetched at once
